# China Weather Hourly Precipitation

Unmodified responses captured on 2026-09-21 with the China Weather Referer:

- `rain_list.jsonp`: `https://d1.weather.com.cn/radar_channel/prec1h/rainList.json?callback=getPreObs1h`
- `prec_2026092122.png`: `https://d1.weather.com.cn/radar_channel/prec1h/prec_2026092122.png`

Tests use captured hourly observations. Reordered/subset lists reuse their
original entries. Invalid callbacks are explicit protocol fault cases.
